text.content:
MaxTac's commander. Built like a heavyweight, quiet like a priest.

Role: Solo (Solo 9), Commander of MaxTac
Affiliation: MaxTac; the Static Night crew
Where to find them: MAX-TAC HQ, Wellsprings, boxing alone in the gym at four in the morning
Known for: Helping end the Purge in 2047; publicly contemptuous of Commissioner Ramos

Contender joined the Static Night crew somewhere in the first night of 2047, out of the wreck of the broadcast wedding, and Max Hammerman had him in MaxTac armor before that night was over. Huge, fast and angry, he kept the anger on a leash nobody else could see. Afterward he went back to MaxTac and climbed until he ran it.

He has hunted cyberpsychos for more than twenty years and never asked to be thanked. He is honest, terrifying, and openly contemptuous of the Commissioner, and his troopers would walk into fire for him. He gave Lyle Thompson one line about 2047: "Stop Sign tells it right. Print his version." Asked about sharing a surname with the bride, he says it's a common name.

GM secrets

Contender was born Luigi Falcone, heir of the Falcone family and the groom at the 2047 broadcast wedding. Gene-tailored and chromed from childhood to be a prince nobody could kill, he paid for it with his anger control. He turned in the wreck of his own wedding, fought beside the crew, and testified for the city; in return he got clemency, treatment (therapy, neural dampers and a chip he never mentions) and a new name, taking the bride's surname. The sealed file is in the Hall of Justice; Commissioner Ramos holds it, which is the real reason the two hate each other. The crew know, and none of them has told.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 02, 05, 10
